steps.title: Confirm Redis and RabbitMQ are reachable from the API host
Start celery_worker and celery_beat (compose or systemd)
GET /api/v1/health/ready shows database, redis, celery_broker ok
GET /api/v1/jobs lists all registered handlers and full beat map
Optional enqueue=true and confirm worker log consumes task
Record soak outcome in ops change log (date, operator, result)
Packaging fidelity tests green (handlers ↔ beat ↔ runbook)

pass_criteria: Deep health ready returns 200 with broker ok when Celery enabled
Jobs API beat map covers all registered handlers
Sync job run succeeds for at least one handler
AI nightly and CI queue-drain are not falsely claimed
